name: NTR Bharosa – Old Age Pension (OAP)
department: Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP) / Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA)
benefits: ₹4,000 per month via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh aged 60 years or above; BPL family with AP Rice Card; monthly family income ≤ ₹10,000 (rural) or ≤ ₹12,000 (urban); wet land ≤ 3 acres or dry land ≤ 10 acres; no government employee, income taxpayer, or four-wheeler owner in the family.
documents_required: Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / SSC Memo)
how_to_apply: Visit the nearest Grama Sachivalayam (rural) or Ward Sachivalayam (urban), submit the application form with documents to the Welfare & Education Assistant, and complete biometric e-KYC verification.

name: NTR Bharosa – Widow & Single Woman Pension
department: SERP / MEPMA, Department of Panchayat Raj & Rural Development
benefits: ₹4,000 per month via DBT.
eligibility: Widows aged 18+ residing in AP; separated/deserted women aged 35+ (separated > 1 year); unmarried women aged 30+ (rural) or 35+ (urban); BPL family with valid AP Rice Card; not receiving any other government pension.
documents_required: Husband's Death Certificate (for widows) or Separation/Unmarried Certificate
how_to_apply: Apply offline at the nearest Grama/Ward Sachivalayam with the required documents and complete biometric verification.

name: NTR Bharosa – Persons with Disabilities (PwD) Pension
department: Department for Welfare of Differently Abled, Transgender & Senior Citizens (via SERP/MEPMA)
benefits: ₹6,000 per month for 40%+ disability; up to ₹15,000 per month for fully bedridden or severe multi-deformity beneficiaries.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh with no age limit; minimum 40% disability certified by a valid SADAREM certificate; BPL household.
how_to_apply: Obtain a SADAREM assessment certificate at a designated government hospital, then submit the pension application at your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: NTR Bharosa – Chronic Disease (CKDU / Thalassemia) Pension
department: SERP / MEPMA & Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department
benefits: ₹10,000 per month for dialysis/CKDU/thalassemia/sickle cell/hemophilia patients; ₹5,000 per month for non-dialysis stage 3–5 CKD patients.
eligibility: AP resident undergoing regular dialysis or treatment for notified chronic diseases at government or NTR Vaidya Seva network hospitals.
how_to_apply: Submit the medical certificate and application at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam for verification by the District Medical & Health Officer (DMHO).

name: NTR Bharosa – Weaver, Toddy Tapper & Fisherman Pension
department: SERP / MEPMA (with Handlooms, Excise & Fisheries Departments)
benefits: ₹4,000 per month via DBT.
eligibility: Permanent AP resident aged 50 years or above belonging to weaving, toddy tapping, or fishing communities; BPL family; not availing another social security pension.
how_to_apply: Submit the application and trade proof at the nearest Grama/Ward Sachivalayam for verification by the MPDO/Municipal Commissioner.

name: NTR Bharosa – Transgender, Cobbler & Dappu Artists Pension
department: Department for Welfare of Differently Abled, Transgender & Senior Citizens / SERP
benefits: ₹4,000 per month via DBT.
eligibility: Eligible transgender persons, traditional cobblers, and Dappu artists aged 18+ domiciled in Andhra Pradesh from economically weaker households.
documents_required: Transgender ID Certificate (or Trade/Artist recognition proof)
how_to_apply: Apply at the local Grama/Ward Sachivalayam with supporting identity and community certificates.

name: Thalliki Vandanam Scheme
department: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹15,000 per year per eligible school-going child (₹13,000 credited to the mother's bank account + ₹2,000 toward school maintenance); no cap on the number of children per family.
eligibility: Mothers or recognized guardians of children studying in Classes 1 to 12 (Intermediate) in recognized schools/junior colleges in AP; BPL/Rice Card household; minimum 75% attendance; electricity usage < 300 units/month; no 4-wheeler or government job.
how_to_apply: Schools upload student admission and attendance data to the School Education portal; mothers verify e-KYC and eligibility at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: Annadata Sukhibhava – PM-KISAN
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + Central Government)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹20,000 per year combined financial assistance (₹14,000 from AP State + ₹6,000 from Central PM-KISAN) transferred in 3 installments via DBT.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer households in Andhra Pradesh (registered in Webland) and eligible CCRC tenant farmers; excludes income taxpayers, serving/retired government employees, and professionals.
documents_required: Pattadar Passbook / Land Record (Webland) or Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC)
how_to_apply: Verify land records with the Village Revenue Officer (VRO), visit the nearest Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) or Grama Sachivalayam, and complete e-KYC and PM-KISAN registration.

name: Deepam 2.0 (Free LPG Cylinders Scheme)
department: Consumer Affairs, Food and Civil Supplies Department, Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 3 free domestic LPG cylinder refills per year (1 cylinder every 4 months), with the subsidy reimbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account within 48 hours of delivery.
eligibility: Eligible AP Rice Cardholder households with an active domestic LPG connection linked to Aadhaar and bank account.
how_to_apply: Ensure e-KYC is updated at your LPG agency, book a cylinder refill as usual, pay on delivery, and receive automatic subsidy reimbursement into your linked bank account.

name: Stree Shakti (Free Bus Travel for Women)
department: Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (APSRTC), Transport Department
benefits: 100% free (zero-fare) bus travel across Andhra Pradesh in Pallevelugu, Ultra Pallevelugu, City Ordinary, Metro Express, and Express APSRTC buses.
eligibility: All women, girls, and transgender persons domiciled in Andhra Pradesh (no income limit); excludes interstate and luxury/AC services.
documents_required: Any valid Government Photo ID showing Andhra Pradesh domicile (Aadhaar Card
how_to_apply: No prior registration required—board an eligible APSRTC bus within AP, show your domicile ID to the conductor, and collect a zero-fare ticket.

name: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (Universal Health Policy)
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY)
department: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department
benefits: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year covering 3,257 procedures across 31 specialties at empanelled network hospitals, plus post-discharge medicines.
eligibility: All eligible AP families (Rice Cardholders and families under the Universal Health Policy framework; insurers cover up to ₹2.5 Lakh and NTR Vaidya Seva Trust covers above that up to ₹25 Lakh).
documents_required: AP Rice Card or Income Certificate
NTR Vaidya Seva / Ayushman Health Card.
how_to_apply: Visit any empanelled network hospital and approach the Aarogyamitra helpdesk with your Aadhaar and Rice/Health Card for cashless pre-authorization.

name: JnanaBhumi Post-Matric Scholarship (RTF – Tuition Fee)
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BC Welfare, EBC & Minority Welfare Departments
benefits: 100% Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (RTF) and prescribed college fees for eligible higher education courses.
eligibility: SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, and Minority students domiciled in AP admitted under Convener Quota in ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, or PG courses; annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh; minimum 75% attendance.
how_to_apply: Register through your college scholarship cell on the JnanaBhumi portal and complete biometric authentication at the college or Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: JnanaBhumi Post-Matric Scholarship (MTF – Maintenance Fee)
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BC Welfare, EBC & Minority Welfare Departments
benefits: Annual maintenance assistance (₹10,000 for ITI, ₹15,000 for Polytechnic, ₹20,000 for Degree/PG/Professional courses) for hostel and mess expenses.
eligibility: AP domiciled SC/ST/BC/EBC/Kapu/Minority students admitted under Convener Quota with annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh and minimum 75% attendance.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the JnanaBhumi portal via your college and complete biometric verification.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarships (SC / ST / BC / Disabled)
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + Central Government)
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BC Welfare & Differently Abled Welfare Departments
benefits: Annual academic stipend and book/hostel grant for school-going students.
eligibility: SC/ST students in Classes 5–10 (family income ≤ ₹2 Lakh/year) and BC/EBC/Disabled students in Classes 5–10 (family income ≤ ₹1 Lakh/year) with 75% attendance.
how_to_apply: Submit application through the school headmaster on the JnanaBhumi portal.

name: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Vidyarthi Mitra
department: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: Free student kit containing 3 pairs of uniforms, textbooks, notebooks, school bag, belt, shoes, socks, and a dictionary.
eligibility: All students enrolled in Classes 1 to 10 in Government, Zilla Parishad, Municipal, and Aided schools in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Automatic distribution at the start of the academic year through the respective government school—no separate application required.

name: Dokka Seethamma Mid-Day Meal Scheme
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + PM POSHAN)
department: Department of School Education & Board of Intermediate Education, AP
benefits: Free nutritious hot cooked lunch (including eggs, chikki, and ragi java) on all working days.
eligibility: All students studying in Government schools (Classes 1–10) and 475 Government Junior Colleges (Intermediate 1st & 2nd year) across Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Automatically provided to all attending students at their school or government junior college.

name: NTR Vidyonnathi (Civil Services Coaching Scheme)
department: Social Welfare, BC Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Minority & Brahmin Welfare Departments
benefits: Full sponsorship for UPSC Civil Services coaching at reputed institutes along with a monthly maintenance stipend.
eligibility: AP domiciled graduates (SC/ST/BC/EBC/Kapu/Minority/Brahmin) with annual family income ≤ ₹6 Lakh who qualify through the state screening test.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the JnanaBhumi portal when the annual NTR Vidyonnathi notification is released and appear for the entrance test.

name: Ambedkar Overseas Vidyanidhi / NTR Videshi Vidyadharana
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BC, EBC, Minority & Brahmin Welfare Departments
benefits: Financial grant of ₹10 Lakh to ₹15 Lakh for PG/PhD studies abroad, plus one-way airfare and visa fee reimbursement.
eligibility: AP domiciled SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority/Kapu/Brahmin graduates aged ≤ 35 years, family income ≤ ₹6 Lakh/year, with confirmed admission in an accredited foreign university.
how_to_apply: Register online on the JnanaBhumi / AP ePass portal, upload admission and income documents, and attend committee verification.

name: Best Available Schools (BAS) Scheme
department: Social Welfare & Tribal Welfare Departments, AP
benefits: Free quality education, books, uniforms, and residential hostel facilities in reputed private schools.
eligibility: Meritorious SC/ST students entering Class 1, 5, or 8 from BPL families (annual income ≤ ₹1 Lakh).
how_to_apply: Apply through the District Social/Tribal Welfare Office or JnanaBhumi portal; selection is done via lottery/merit list.

name: Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education
department: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (APBWC)
benefits: Financial assistance ranging from ₹12,000 to ₹36,000 per year depending on the Vedic course.
eligibility: Brahmin community students aged 8 to 19 years whose parents reside in AP and who are pursuing full-time Vedic studies (Rig, Yajur, Sama, Atharva Veda, or Smartham) in recognized Veda Pathashalas.
how_to_apply: Visit the AP Brahmin Welfare Corporation portal, go to Schemes -> Registration, fill out the form, and upload documents.

name: Divyang Shakti (Free Bus Travel for Persons with Disabilities)
department: Transport Department / APSRTC
benefits: 100% free bus travel for PwDs across 21 recognized disability categories and 50% fare concession for one escort in eligible APSRTC buses.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh with 40% or more disability certified under the RPwD Act.
how_to_apply: Apply for the APSRTC Divyang bus pass online or at APSRTC bus depot counters, or present valid UDID/SADAREM ID as per APSRTC guidelines.

name: Zero Poverty – P4 (Bangaru Kutumbam Initiative)
department: Planning Department & Village/Ward Secretariats (GSWS)
benefits: Customized financial, education, housing, skill, and livelihood upliftment support connecting vulnerable families (*Bangaru Kutumbams*) with mentors/donors (*Margadarsis*).
eligibility: Bottom-of-the-pyramid vulnerable households in AP identified through Gram Sabha/Ward Sabha verification (no government employee, non-taxpayer, wet land ≤ 2 acres or total land ≤ 5 acres).
how_to_apply: Families are identified via Grama/Ward Sabha surveys; citizens can also check or update household details at their Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: Chandranna Bima (Unorganised Workers Insurance)
department: Labour Department & SERP, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹5 Lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹3.62 Lakh for partial disability; ₹1–2 Lakh for natural death (age 18–50).
eligibility: Unorganised sector primary breadwinner in AP from a BPL/Rice Card family aged 18 to 70 years (18–50 for natural death).
documents_required: Death Certificate / FIR / Disability Certificate (at the time of claim).
how_to_apply: Enroll or verify nominee details through the Welfare Assistant at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (via NABARD & Banks)
benefits: Short-term collateral-free crop loans up to ₹1.6 Lakh (higher with collateral) at an effective 4% interest rate (with 3% prompt repayment subvention) for seeds, fertilizers, and allied activities.
eligibility: All individual/joint owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, SHGs, and animal husbandry/fisheries farmers.
documents_required: Land Ownership Record (Pattadar Passbook / 1B) or Tenancy Proof (CCRC)
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial, regional rural, or cooperative bank branch, or online via the PM-KISAN / JanSamarth portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY – AP Crop Insurance)
department: Department of Agriculture, AP & Ministry of Agriculture, GoI
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance payout against yield loss due to drought, flood, cyclone, pests, or unseasonal rain at nominal farmer premium (1.5%–2% or state-subsidized).
eligibility: All loanee and non-loanee farmers and CCRC tenant farmers cultivating notified crops in AP who complete e-Crop booking before the seasonal cut-off date.
how_to_apply: Complete e-Crop registration at your Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) or enroll through your bank/CSC/PMFBY portal before the crop cut-off date.

name: Sunna Vaddi Panta Runalu (Zero-Interest Crop Loans)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 100% interest reimbursement (0% effective interest) on short-term crop loans up to ₹1 Lakh.
eligibility: Small and marginal AP farmers (wet land ≤ 5 acres or dry land ≤ 10 acres) and CCRC tenant farmers who complete e-Crop booking and repay their crop loan on or before the due date.
how_to_apply: Repay your crop loan on time at your bank; banks upload repayment data to the Agriculture portal for direct interest reimbursement.

name: NTR Jala Siri (Free Borewell & Irrigation Scheme)
department: Department of Rural Development / Agriculture, AP
benefits: 100% free borewell drilling and, where eligible, pump-set subsidy for reliable irrigation.
eligibility: Small and marginal AP farmers (2.5 to 5 acres contiguous land) without an existing borewell, subject to hydrogeological survey approval.
how_to_apply: Submit application at the Grama Sachivalayam or Rythu Seva Kendram for joint hydrogeological inspection and sanction.

name: Agricultural Input Subsidy (Drought & Flood Relief)
department: Disaster Management & Agriculture Department, AP
benefits: Direct per-hectare financial compensation (₹8,500 to ₹17,000/hectare depending on crop type) for ≥ 33% crop damage.
eligibility: Farmers in AP whose crops suffer ≥ 33% damage due to drought, cyclone, heavy rain, or flood as verified in e-Crop and joint enumeration.
how_to_apply: Ensure e-Crop booking is done; after calamity, verify your name in the social audit list displayed at the Rythu Seva Kendram.

name: Farm Mechanization & Custom Hiring Centres Subsidy
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + SMAM Central)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on agricultural implements (power tillers, sprayers, rotavators, harvesters) and tractors for farmer groups.
eligibility: Individual AP farmers (for implements) and registered Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) / Rythu Mithra groups (for Custom Hiring Centres).
how_to_apply: Apply at the Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) or through the AP Agriculture Department portal during the subsidy window.

name: Subsidized Seed & Soil Health Card Programme
department: Department of Agriculture (D-Krishi), AP
benefits: 50%–60% subsidy on certified paddy, groundnut, pulse, and green manure seeds, plus free soil health testing and micronutrient subsidies.
eligibility: All cultivating farmers in Andhra Pradesh verified via Aadhaar and Webland/CCRC.
how_to_apply: Register your seed requirement at the Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) via biometric authentication on the D-Krishi portal.

name: Pasu Nasta Parihara Padhakam (Livestock Loss Compensation)
department: Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹30,000 per high-yielding cow/buffalo; ₹15,000 per indigenous cattle; ₹6,000 per sheep/goat/pig in case of accidental or disease-related death.
eligibility: Livestock farmers in AP whose ear-tagged animals die due to contagious disease, lightning, snakebite, or natural calamities.
how_to_apply: Inform the local Veterinary Assistant at the Rythu Seva Kendram immediately for post-mortem verification and claim upload.

name: Matsyakara Sevalo (Fishing Ban Relief & Diesel Subsidy)
department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹20,000 per year financial relief during the 61-day marine fishing ban, ₹9/litre diesel subsidy, and ₹10 Lakh accidental ex-gratia.
eligibility: Registered AP marine fishermen aged 21–60 years (excludes mechanized boat owners and government pensioners).
how_to_apply: Verify beneficiary details with the Village Fisheries Assistant at the Grama Sachivalayam before the annual ban period.

name: NTR Baby Kit Scheme
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Free newborn care kit worth ₹1,410 containing 14 essentials (baby bed with mosquito net, clothes, towels, nappies, oil, soap, powder, shampoo, rattle).
eligibility: Mothers domiciled in Andhra Pradesh who deliver a live baby in any Government Hospital, PHC, CHC, or Government Medical College.
how_to_apply: Distributed free of cost at the government hospital before discharge—no separate application needed.

name: Stree Nidhi SHG Micro-Credit Loans
department: Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative Federation (SERP / MEPMA)
benefits: Collateral-free, low-interest livelihood loans up to ₹1 Lakh–₹3 Lakh disbursed within 48 hours via mobile app.
eligibility: Active women members of Grade A/B registered Self-Help Groups (SHGs/DWCRA) in rural or urban AP with a clean repayment record.
how_to_apply: Submit a loan request through your Village Organization Assistant (VOA) or Slum Level Federation (SLF) resource person.

name: Sunna Vaddi for SHG Women (Zero-Interest SHG Loans)
department: SERP / MEPMA, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 100% interest reimbursement on SHG bank-linkage loans up to ₹5 Lakh.
eligibility: Active BPL women Self-Help Groups in AP maintaining regular monthly loan repayments (non-NPA accounts).
how_to_apply: Automatically processed through bank-SHG linkage data verified by SERP/MEPMA; confirm account status with your VOA/CRP.

name: Bala Sanjeevani / Sampoorna Poshana (Maternal & Child Nutrition)
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + ICDS/Mission Poshan 2.0)
department: Women Development & Child Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Free take-home nutritious food rations, milk, eggs, and hot cooked meals at Anganwadi Centres.
eligibility: Pregnant women, lactating mothers, and children aged 6 months to 6 years registered at AP Anganwadi centres.
how_to_apply: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre with your Aadhaar and MCP card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development / AP WDCW Dept
benefits: ₹5,000 for the first live child and ₹6,000 for the second child (if a girl) via DBT for maternity nutrition and wage compensation.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating mothers aged 19+ from economically weaker/BPL families (excludes regular government employees).
how_to_apply: Register at your local Anganwadi Centre or online via the PMMVY citizen portal.

name: NTR Vaidya Pariksha (Free Diagnostic Tests)
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Free diagnostic lab tests (60+ blood, urine, X-ray, ECG, and ultrasound tests) at government health facilities.
eligibility: All patients visiting Government PHCs, CHCs, Area Hospitals, and District Hospitals in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Walk into any government hospital/PHC and get prescribed tests done free of charge at the in-house diagnostic hub.

name: Talli Bidda Express (102 Free Post-Natal Drop-Back)
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department (102 Call Centre)
benefits: 100% free GPS-enabled vehicle drop-back from government hospital to home for mother and newborn, plus follow-up checkup rides.
eligibility: Any mother and newborn discharged after delivery at a Government hospital in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Dial 102 or request booking through the hospital maternity ward staff at the time of discharge.

name: NTR Anna Canteens (₹5 Subsidized Meals)
department: Municipal Administration & Urban Development (MA&UD) Department
benefits: Nutritious hot breakfast, lunch, and dinner at ₹5 per meal (₹15/day total) across 205+ urban canteens in AP.
eligibility: Open to all citizens (daily wage workers, students, patients, urban poor—no income proof or ID required).
how_to_apply: Visit any nearest Anna Canteen during meal timings and purchase a ₹5 meal token.

name: NTR Housing Scheme / PMAY-G & PMAY-U
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + Central PMAY)
department: AP State Housing Corporation Ltd (APSHCL)
benefits: Free house site patta plus ₹1.5 Lakh to ₹2.5 Lakh construction financial assistance (with additional top-up for SC/ST/BC beneficiaries).
eligibility: Homeless BPL / Rice Card families in AP who do not own a pucca house or government house site anywhere in India.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam or online via the PMAY / AP Housing portal during beneficiary surveys.

name: AP TIDCO Affordable Urban Flats
department: Andhra Pradesh Township & Infrastructure Development Corporation (APTIDCO)
benefits: Subsidized G+3 urban apartments (300, 365, and 430 sq.ft); 300 sq.ft units heavily subsidized for eligible EWS beneficiaries with bank loan linkage.
eligibility: Urban AP residents in EWS (monthly income ≤ ₹25,000) or LIG (₹25,001–₹50,000) without a pucca house.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Municipal Commissioner / Ward Sachivalayam when urban housing allotments open.

name: Jagjeevan Jyothi (Free Electricity for SC / ST Households)
department: Energy Department (APSPDCL / APEPDCL / APCPDCL)
benefits: 100% free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month.
eligibility: Eligible SC and ST domestic electricity consumers domiciled in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Submit your Caste Certificate and electricity meter service number at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam or local DISCOM office.

name: Free Electricity for Handloom & Powerloom Weavers
department: Department of Handlooms and Textiles, AP
benefits: Free electricity up to 200 units/month for handloom weaver households and up to 500 units/month for eligible powerloom units.
eligibility: Active handloom weaver households and registered powerloom units operating in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Submit Weaver ID and electricity service number at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam or Handlooms & Textiles office for DISCOM linkage.

name: Auto Driver Sevalo Scheme
department: Transport Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹15,000 per year financial assistance for vehicle insurance, fitness certificate, and maintenance expenses.
eligibility: AP resident aged 18+ who is an owner-cum-driver of an AP-registered auto-rickshaw, taxi, or maxi-cab from a BPL/eligible household.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam with vehicle RC and driving license for Transport Department verification.

name: Targeted Public Distribution System (AP Rice Subsidy Scheme)
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + NFSA Central)
department: Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies Department, AP
benefits: Subsidized/free fortified rice (5 kg per person/month for PHH; 35 kg/family/month for Antyodaya Anna Yojana) plus subsidized dal and sugar at Fair Price Shops.
eligibility: Eligible BPL / Priority Household (PHH) and Antyodaya (AAY) families holding a valid AP Rice Card.
how_to_apply: Apply for a new Rice Card or add family members at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam; collect monthly rations at your Fair Price Shop.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana (Traditional Artisans Support)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest, and digital transaction incentives.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople aged 18+ across 18 trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, tailors, barbers, washermen, goldsmiths, cobblers, etc.).
how_to_apply: Register via any Common Service Centre (CSC) or online on the PM Vishwakarma portal using biometric authentication.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors Micro-Credit Scheme)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented in Urban AP via MEPMA)
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / AP MEPMA
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans starting at ₹10,000 (upgradable to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment), 7% interest subsidy, and digital cashback rewards.
eligibility: Urban street vendors, hawkers, and pushcart sellers operating in Andhra Pradesh towns/cities with a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the PM SVANidhi portal or through your nearest Ward Sachivalayam / MEPMA office / CSC.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar Subsidy)
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefits: Up to 300 units of free electricity per month via rooftop solar, with a direct central subsidy of ₹30,000 (1 kW), ₹60,000 (2 kW), or ₹78,000 (3 kW+).
eligibility: Indian citizens owning a house with a suitable roof and a valid domestic electricity connection in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM Surya Ghar national portal, select your AP DISCOM, get feasibility approval, install via an empanelled vendor, and claim DBT subsidy.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (Girl Child Savings Scheme)
state_or_central: Central (Available at all Post Offices & Banks in AP)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefits: High-interest (8.2% p.a. subject to quarterly revision), tax-free (EEE) savings account for a girl child's higher education and marriage, maturing after 21 years.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age (maximum 2 accounts per family, or 3 in case of twins/triplets).
how_to_apply: Open an account with a minimum deposit of ₹250 at any India Post Office or authorized public/private sector bank branch.

name: Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) Integrated Agri-Advisory & Input Services
department: Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, AP
benefits: Village-level one-stop access to quality-tested seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, soil/seed testing, e-Crop booking, and real-time crop advisory.
eligibility: All cultivating farmers and CCRC tenant farmers across rural Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Visit your local village Rythu Seva Kendram and register your requirement with the Village Agriculture/Horticulture Assistant.

name: Andhra Pradesh Micro Irrigation Project (APMIP – Drip & Sprinkler Subsidy)
state_or_central: Joint (State of Andhra Pradesh + PMKSY Per Drop More Crop)
department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 55% to 90% subsidy (up to 90%–100% for SC/ST small & marginal farmers in notified mandals) on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: AP farmers owning agricultural/horticultural land (up to 5 hectares) with an assured irrigation water source.
how_to_apply: Register online on the APMIP portal or through the Horticulture Officer at your Rythu Seva Kendram.

name: AP MSME One & Industrial Development Policy Subsidies
department: Department of Industries, Commerce & Export Promotion, AP
benefits: Investment subsidy, power cost reimbursement, SGST reimbursement, stamp duty exemption, and interest subsidy for Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (with enhanced incentives for SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs).
eligibility: Registered MSME units setting up or expanding manufacturing/service operations in Andhra Pradesh with valid Udyam Registration.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the AP MSME One / Single Desk Portal (`apindustries.gov.in`).

name: AP Nethanna Nestham / Handloom Weavers Financial & Loom Modernization Support
department: Department of Handlooms and Textiles, AP
benefits: Annual financial assistance and up to 90% subsidy on modern handlooms, jacquards, dobbies, and yarn/dyeing inputs for weaver households.
eligibility: Traditional handloom weaver families owning and operating a handloom in Andhra Pradesh from BPL/eligible households.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Grama/Ward Sachivalayam or District Handlooms & Textiles Office for physical verification of the loom.

name: AP Brahmin Welfare Corporation – Bharati Education & Chanakya Entrepreneurship Schemes
department: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (APBWC)
benefits: Educational scholarships (₹10,000–₹20,000/yr) for Inter/Degree/PG/Professional students and subsidized entrepreneurship/self-employment loans.
eligibility: Economically weaker Brahmin students and youth domiciled in Andhra Pradesh with annual family income ≤ ₹3 Lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the APBWC official portal under the respective scheme notification.

name: AP Kapu Welfare & Development Corporation – Self-Employment & Skill Support
department: AP State Kapu Welfare and Development Corporation Ltd
benefits: Bank-linked financial subsidy and skill training programs for youth and women from Kapu, Balija, Telaga, and Ontari communities.
eligibility: Domiciled AP residents aged 21–45 belonging to Kapu/Balija/Telaga/Ontari communities with annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh.
how_to_apply: Register through the Online Beneficiary Management & Monitoring System (OBMMS) portal (`apobmms.apcfss.in`) via Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: AP BC Welfare Corporation – Economic Support & Self-Employment Scheme
department: Backward Classes Welfare Department (56 BC Corporations)
benefits: Subsidized bank-linked loans and unit cost subsidies for setting up micro-enterprises, dairy units, and traditional occupational units.
eligibility: Backward Class (BC-A, BC-B, BC-C, BC-D, BC-E) residents of AP aged 21–50 from BPL families.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the AP OBMMS portal through your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam during open application windows.

name: AP SC Cooperative Finance Corporation – Economic Support & Land Purchase Scheme
department: Social Welfare Department / APSCCFC
benefits: Bank-linked self-employment subsidy, transport vehicle units, and agricultural land purchase/development assistance for landless SC families.
eligibility: Scheduled Caste (SC) residents of Andhra Pradesh aged 21–50 from BPL households.
how_to_apply: Apply online on `apobmms.apcfss.in` or at your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: TRICOR (AP Tribal Cooperative Finance Corporation) Economic Support Scheme
department: Tribal Welfare Department / TRICOR
benefits: Margin money and subsidy support for tribal youth and women to start micro-enterprises, agro-processing, and forest produce units.
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe (ST) residents of Andhra Pradesh aged 18–50 from BPL families.
how_to_apply: Apply through the ITDA / District Tribal Welfare Office or on the OBMMS portal via Grama Sachivalayam.

name: AP State Minorities Finance Corporation – Economic Support & Dulhan / Shaadi Assistance
department: Minorities Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Subsidized bank-linked self-employment loans, skill training, and financial assistance for eligible minority families.
eligibility: Minority community residents (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) domiciled in AP with annual family income ≤ ₹1.5 Lakh (rural) / ₹2 Lakh (urban).
how_to_apply: Submit application online via `apobmms.apcfss.in` or through the District Minorities Welfare Office.

name: AP Building and Other Construction Workers (APBoCW) Welfare Schemes
department: Labour Department (AP Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board)
benefits: Financial assistance for maternity (₹20,000), marriage of daughters (₹20,000), natural death (₹1.3 Lakh), accidental death (₹6 Lakh), hospitalization, and children's scholarships.
eligibility: Registered construction workers in AP aged 18–60 who have worked at least 90 days in building/construction work in the preceding year.
how_to_apply: Register as a construction worker at the Labour Department office or Grama/Ward Sachivalayam and submit benefit claims online.

name: AP State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) Free Skill & Placement Training
department: Department of Skill Development & Training, AP
benefits: Free industry-aligned technical, IT, manufacturing, healthcare, and soft-skills training with certification and job placement drives (Job Melas).
eligibility: Unemployed youth and students domiciled in Andhra Pradesh aged 18–35 (minimum qualification varies from Class 10 to Degree/Engineering).
how_to_apply: Register online on the APSSDC portal (`apssdc.in`) and enroll in a nearby Skill Hub or Skill College.

name: DDU-GKY (Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana – AP)
department: SEEDAP (Society for Employment Generation & Enterprise Development in AP)
benefits: Free residential/non-residential skill training, free uniforms, study material, food/accommodation, and guaranteed placement with post-placement tracking support.
eligibility: Rural youth in Andhra Pradesh aged 15–35 (up to 45 for SC/ST/Women/PwD) from BPL / MGNREGA / SHG households.
how_to_apply: Mobilize through your Village Organization / Grama Sachivalayam or apply via SEEDAP training centres.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA – AP)
department: Department of Panchayat Raj & Rural Development, AP
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days (150 days in drought/tribal areas) of unskilled wage employment per rural household per financial year at notified daily wage rates.
eligibility: Any adult member (aged 18+) of a rural household in Andhra Pradesh willing to do unskilled manual labor.
how_to_apply: Apply at your Grama Sachivalayam / Gram Panchayat for a free MGNREGA Job Card, then submit a written/oral request for work.

name: 104 Mobile Medical Units (MMU) & 24×7 Tele-Health Helpline
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Free doorstep monthly doctor consultations in villages, non-communicable disease (BP/diabetes) screening, free medicines, and 24×7 medical advice via toll-free 104.
eligibility: All rural, tribal, and urban residents of Andhra Pradesh.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card or Mobile Number (optional for walk-in care).
how_to_apply: Visit the 104 Mobile Medical Unit on its scheduled village visit day or dial 104 from any phone.

name: Dr. YSR / NTR Kanti Velugu (Universal Eye Screening & Free Spectacles)
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Free comprehensive eye checkups, free prescription spectacles, and free cataract/corneal surgeries at government and empanelled eye hospitals.
eligibility: All school children, senior citizens, and residents of Andhra Pradesh needing vision care.
how_to_apply: Attend screening camps at schools, PHCs, or Village Clinics.

name: Free Dialysis Centres under NTR Vaidya Seva / National Dialysis Programme
department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, AP
benefits: Completely free hemodialysis sessions (3 times a week), free erythropoietin injections, and ₹10,000/month pension support for eligible CKD patients.
eligibility: Patients diagnosed with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) / Chronic Kidney Disease residing in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Register at any Government General Hospital, Area Hospital, or CHC dialysis unit in AP.

name: AP Tribal Sub-Plan – Giri Poshana (Nutrition for Pregnant & Lactating Tribal Women)
department: Tribal Welfare & Women and Child Welfare Departments, AP
benefits: Additional fortified nutritional food basket (ragi flour, jaggery, groundnut chikki, dry fruits, milk, eggs) to prevent anemia and malnutrition in tribal areas.
eligibility: Pregnant women, lactating mothers, and severely underweight children residing in Scheduled Tribal (ITDA) mandals of Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Automatically provided through Anganwadi Centres in tribal areas.

name: Bala Raksha Bhavan & Foster Care / Sponsorship Scheme (Mission Vatsalya)
department: Department of Women Development & Child Welfare, AP
benefits: ₹4,000 per month financial sponsorship for orphaned, semi-orphaned, or vulnerable children living with extended family/foster parents for education and nutrition.
eligibility: Children below 18 years in Andhra Pradesh who have lost one or both parents or whose parents are terminally ill/incapacitated, from economically weak families.
how_to_apply: Apply through the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or Child Welfare Committee (CWC) via your Anganwadi / Ward Secretariat.

name: AP Free Legal Aid Services (APSLSA)
state_or_central: Joint (NALSA Central + Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority)
department: Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority (High Court of AP)
benefits: 100% free advocate representation, court fee exemption, drafting of petitions, and Lok Adalat mediation in civil, criminal, family, and labour cases.
eligibility: Women, children, SC/ST members, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, industrial workmen, victims of trafficking/disaster, and citizens with annual income ≤ ₹3 Lakh.
documents_required: Income Certificate / Caste or Disability Proof (as applicable)
how_to_apply: Walk into any District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or Mandal Legal Services Committee (MLSC) at the local court complex, or apply online on the NALSA portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
state_or_central: Central (Available across all Banks in AP)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefits: ₹2 Lakh life insurance cover payable to the nominee upon the insured's death due to any cause, at a nominal premium of ₹436 per year.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 50 years holding an individual savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent.
how_to_apply: Enroll via net banking/mobile banking, at your bank branch, or through a Bank Mitra / Grama Sachivalayam Digital Assistant.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
state_or_central: Central (Available across all Banks in AP)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefits: ₹2 Lakh accidental death and total permanent disability insurance cover (₹1 Lakh for partial disability) at just ₹20 per year.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 70 years holding a savings bank or post office account.
how_to_apply: Activate auto-debit at your bank branch, via mobile banking, or through a Business Correspondent.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
state_or_central: Central (Available across all Banks & Post Offices in AP)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 starting at age 60, with spouse pension and corpus return to nominee.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank account who are not income taxpayers.
how_to_apply: Fill out the APY subscriber registration form at your bank branch or apply online via your bank's mobile app / eNPS portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY – Shishu, Kishore, Tarun & Tarun Plus)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh for non-corporate, non-farm micro/small enterprises: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001–₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5–₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (₹10–₹20 Lakh for repeat borrowers).
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for manufacturing, trading, services, or allied agriculture activities.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the JanSamarth / Udyamimitra portal or visit any public/private bank branch.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SC / ST & Women Entrepreneurs)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented across AP Scheduled Commercial Banks)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits: Composite bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading, or agri-allied sectors.
eligibility: SC or ST entrepreneurs and Women entrepreneurs aged 18+ starting a first-time greenfield business (51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST/Woman).
how_to_apply: Apply online via the Stand-Up India / JanSamarth portal or directly at any bank branch.

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented in AP via KVIC, KVIB & DIC)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 15%–25% (urban) and 25%–35% (rural, SC/ST/Women/Minorities/PwD) on new micro-enterprises up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakh (services).
eligibility: Any individual aged 18+ (minimum Class 8 pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing or ₹5 Lakh in services).
how_to_apply: Submit application online on the KVIC PMEGP e-Portal (`kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal`).

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME – AP)
department: AP Food Processing Society, Industries & Commerce Dept
benefits: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 Lakh per unit for individual micro food processors/FPOs/SHGs, plus ₹40,000 seed capital per SHG member.
eligibility: Existing or new individual micro food processing entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, and cooperatives aged 18+ in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the MoFPI PMFME portal (`pmfme.mofpi.gov.in`) or contact the District Resource Person (DRP) at the District Industries Centre.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum and CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage on loans up to ₹2 Crore for post-harvest management infrastructure (cold storages, warehouses, grading/sorting units, primary processing).
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, SHGs, agri-entrepreneurs, and startups in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Agriculture Infra Financing Facility portal (`agriinfra.dac.gov.in`).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY – AP Aquaculture)
department: Department of Fisheries, AP & Ministry of Fisheries, GoI
benefits: 40% subsidy (general) and 60% subsidy (Women/SC/ST) on aquaculture ponds, biofloc units, recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS), insulated vehicles, and fish kiosks.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, FFPOs, and fisheries entrepreneurs in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal through the District Fisheries Officer or AP Fisheries portal.

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM – Entrepreneurship Development in AP)
department: Animal Husbandry Department, AP
benefits: 50% back-ended capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakh) for establishing rural poultry hatcheries, sheep/goat breeding farms, piggery, and fodder processing units.
eligibility: Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, and Section 8 companies in Andhra Pradesh with land/lease availability.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the NLM Udyamimitra portal (`nlm.udyamimitra.in`) for State Implementing Agency (SIA) recommendation.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps & Feeder Solarization)
department: New & Renewable Energy Development Corporation of AP (NREDCAP)
benefits: 60% combined central and state subsidy (plus 30% bank loan option) for installing standalone off-grid solar agriculture water pumps and solarizing existing grid-connected pumps.
eligibility: Individual farmers, water user associations, and farmer groups in Andhra Pradesh with agricultural land and irrigation water source.
how_to_apply: Apply through NREDCAP or AP DISCOM portals when seasonal allotments are notified.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (Free Assisted Living Devices for Senior Citizens)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented across AP Districts via ALIMCO)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: Free physical aids and assisted-living devices (walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, tripods, hearing aids, wheelchairs, artificial dentures, spectacles) based on medical assessment.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to BPL families (or monthly income ≤ ₹15,000) suffering from age-related disabilities/infirmities.
documents_required: BPL / Rice Card or Income Certificate
how_to_apply: Attend ALIMCO assessment camps organized by the District Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Welfare Office.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Aids & Appliances)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
benefits: Free or subsidized modern assistive devices (motorized tricycles, smart canes, hearing aids, prosthetic limbs, Braille kits, wheelchairs).
eligibility: Indian citizens of any age with 40% or more certified disability and monthly family income up to ₹22,500 (100% free) or ₹22,501–₹30,000 (50% subsidy).
how_to_apply: Apply online on the ADIP / DEPwD portal or through district-level ALIMCO distribution camps.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age / Widow / Disability Pension (NSAP – AP Component)
state_or_central: Central (Integrated into AP's NTR Bharosa Pension)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / AP SERP
benefits: Central pension contribution (₹200–₹500/month) merged seamlessly into AP's ₹4,000–₹6,000/month NTR Bharosa pension payout.
eligibility: BPL senior citizens (60+), BPL widows (40–79), and BPL persons with severe/multiple disabilities (80%+).
how_to_apply: Automatically covered when applying for NTR Bharosa Pension at your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS – Class 8 Students)
state_or_central: Central (Conducted in AP by Directorate of Government Examinations)
department: Ministry of Education / AP School Education Dept
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000/month) scholarship from Class 9 to Class 12 to prevent school dropouts.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 8 in Government, Local Body, or Government-Aided schools in AP with parental annual income ≤ ₹3.5 Lakh and ≥ 55% marks in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST), who qualify in the NMMS exam.
how_to_apply: Register for the AP NMMS exam via `bse.ap.gov.in` through your school, qualify the exam, and claim annually on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: PM YASASVI / Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹12,000 per year during UG (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per year during PG/4th–5th year of professional courses.
eligibility: Students who score above the 80th percentile in the AP Board of Intermediate Education (BIEAP) Class 12 exam, pursuing regular full-time degree/professional courses with parental income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`) using One-Time Registration (OTR).

name: AICTE Pragati (Girl Students) & Saksham (PwD Students) Technical Scholarships
state_or_central: Central (Applicable to AP Engineering & Polytechnic Students)
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study (up to 4 years for Degree / 3 years for Diploma) toward tuition fees, books, and laptop/equipment.
eligibility: Girl students (Pragati, up to 2 girls per family) and students with ≥40% disability (Saksham) admitted to 1st year of AICTE-approved Degree or Diploma courses in AP with family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`).

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM / AP MEPMA)
department: Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA), AP
benefits: Formation of urban women SHGs, ₹10,000 revolving fund per SHG, subsidized individual/group micro-enterprise loans (SEP), free skill training (EST&P), and urban homeless shelters.
eligibility: Urban poor households (BPL / Rice Cardholders) residing in municipalities and municipal corporations across Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Contact the Community Organizer (CO) or Resource Person (RP) at your Ward Sachivalayam / Municipal Office.

name: Swachh Andhra – Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) Construction Incentive
state_or_central: Joint (Central SBM-G / SBM-U + State of Andhra Pradesh)
department: Swachh Andhra Corporation / Rural Water Supply & Sanitation Dept
benefits: ₹12,000 (rural) to ₹15,000 (urban) financial incentive paid in installments for constructing a sanitary household toilet.
eligibility: Rural and urban households in Andhra Pradesh without an existing functional household toilet (priority to BPL, SC/ST, small/marginal farmers, and women-headed households).
how_to_apply: Apply at your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam or online on the Swachh Bharat Mission portal (`swachhbharatmission.ddws.gov.in`).

name: Jana Suraksha & PM Jeevan Suraksha – e-Shram Unorganised Worker Registration & Accident Cover
state_or_central: Central (Implemented across AP Common Service Centres & Sachivalayams)
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
benefits: Universal UAN e-Shram Card for unorganised workers, ₹2 Lakh accidental death/permanent disability insurance (via PMSBY linkage), and priority access to central/state social security benefits.
eligibility: Any unorganised sector worker (agricultural labourer, migrant worker, domestic worker, gig/platform worker, street vendor, weaver, fisherman) aged 16–59 who is not an EPFO/ESIC member or income taxpayer.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (linked with active mobile number)
how_to_apply: Self-register free of cost on `eshram.gov.in` or visit any Grama/Ward Sachivalayam Digital Assistant / CSC.
