name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY – Organic Farming)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: ₹31,500 per hectare over 3 years (including ₹15,000/ha DBT for organic inputs, cluster formation, certification, and marketing).
eligibility: Farmers forming organic farming clusters of at least 20 hectares (50 acres) with landholding up to 2 hectares per farmer.
how_to_apply: Register through your local Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) or District Agriculture Office under the PGS-India organic cluster programme.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
state_or_central: Central (Integrated with AP Agricultural Market Yards)
department: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC), Ministry of Agriculture
benefits: Pan-India electronic trading portal enabling transparent online auction of farm produce, better price discovery, and direct online payment to farmer bank accounts.
eligibility: All farmers, FPOs, and licensed traders selling agricultural commodities at e-NAM integrated APMC mandis.
how_to_apply: Register free of cost on the e-NAM portal/mobile app or at the nearest e-NAM integrated Agricultural Market Committee (AMC) gate.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented via AP Animal Husbandry Dept)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI
benefits: Free nationwide artificial insemination, sex-sorted semen subsidies, IVF embryo transfer incentives (₹5,000 per assured pregnancy), and up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crore) for breed multiplication farms.
eligibility: Dairy farmers, gaushalas, SHGs, FPOs, and livestock entrepreneurs.
how_to_apply: Contact your local Veterinary Dispensary for breeding services or apply on the Udyamimitra portal for breed farm subsidies.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI
benefits: 3% interest subvention on loans (up to 90% of project cost) plus 25% credit guarantee coverage for dairy processing, meat processing, animal feed plants, and veterinary vaccine units.
eligibility: FPOs, MSMEs, private companies, Section 8 companies, and individual entrepreneurs.
how_to_apply: Submit application and DPR online via the AHIDF Udyamimitra portal.

name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
department: National Bee Board, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Subsidies on bee colonies, bee boxes, honey extraction equipment, testing labs, and free scientific beekeeping training for "Sweet Revolution" income generation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural youth, women SHGs, FPOs, and beekeeping cooperatives.
how_to_apply: Register on the Madhukranti portal and submit proposals through the State Horticulture/Agriculture Department.

name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Ensures Minimum Support Price (MSP) to farmers for pulses, oilseeds, and copra via Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Private Procurement Stockist Scheme.
eligibility: Registered farmers cultivating notified pulses, oilseeds, and copra.
how_to_apply: Register crop details on the state e-Crop / procurement portal and sell produce at notified NAFED / MARKFED procurement centres.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / AP Horticulture Dept
benefits: 40%–50% subsidy for new orchards (mango, banana, citrus, pomegranate), polyhouses/shade-nets, pack houses, cold storages, and plastic mulching.
eligibility: All horticulture farmers, FPOs, and agri-entrepreneurs with cultivable land.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Village Horticulture Assistant at your Rythu Seva Kendram or District Horticulture Office.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Subsidized high-yielding seeds, micronutrients, bio-fertilizers, cluster demonstrations, and farm implements for rice, pulses, coarse cereals, and nutri-cereals (millets).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and general farmers cultivating notified foodgrain crops in designated districts.
how_to_apply: Contact the Village Agriculture Assistant at your Rythu Seva Kendram during Kharif/Rabi input distribution.

name: Sub-Mission on Agroforestry (SMAF)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: 50% financial assistance for planting timber/fruit trees along farm bunds ("Har Medh Par Ped"), nursery raising, and peripheral plantation.
eligibility: Farmers with valid Soil Health Cards willing to plant trees alongside agricultural crops.
how_to_apply: Apply through the District Agriculture / Social Forestry Office.

name: Krishi Udan 2.0 Scheme
department: Ministry of Civil Aviation (with Ministry of Agriculture)
benefits: Waiver of airport landing, parking, and terminal navigation charges for cargo airlines transporting perishable agricultural produce (fruits, vegetables, marine/fishery products) from notified airports (including Visakhapatnam/Vijayawada corridors).
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, agri-exporters, and cargo aggregators shipping perishables by air.
how_to_apply: Coordinate shipments through empanelled air-cargo hubs and the e-KUSHAL digital platform.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY – Food Processing)
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
benefits: 35% to 50% capital grant-in-aid (up to ₹5–10 Crore depending on component) for Mega Food Parks, Integrated Cold Chains, Agro-Processing Clusters, and Food Testing Labs.
eligibility: Private companies, FPOs, NGOs, cooperatives, SHGs, and state corporations.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the MoFPI SAMPADA portal against open Expressions of Interest (EoI).

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs Scheme
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (via NABARD, SFAC, NCDC)
benefits: Up to ₹18 Lakh financial support per FPO over 3 years for management costs, plus matching equity grant up to ₹15 Lakh and credit guarantee cover up to ₹2 Crore.
eligibility: Groups of at least 300 farmers in plain areas (100 in tribal/hilly areas) forming a Farmer Producer Organization.
documents_required: FPO Incorporation Certificate (Companies Act / Cooperative Act)
how_to_apply: Connect with Cluster Based Business Organizations (CBBOs) empanelled by NABARD/SFAC in your district.

name: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (SPMRM)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
benefits: Urban-grade infrastructure (piped water, street lights, digital literacy, agro-processing, skill centres, LPG, solid waste management) in rural clusters while preserving rural soul.
eligibility: Identified Rurban clusters of contiguous villages with 25,000–50,000 population (5,000–15,000 in tribal areas).
documents_required: Not applicable for individual citizens (cluster-level infrastructure).
how_to_apply: Implemented by District Collectors and Gram Panchayats; citizens benefit directly from cluster amenities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
state_or_central: Central (Implemented by AP Panchayat Raj Engineering Dept)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
benefits: Construction and upgradation of all-weather paved roads connecting unconnected rural habitations to markets, schools, and hospitals.
eligibility: Unconnected rural habitations with population ≥ 500 in plains (≥ 250 in tribal/hilly areas).
how_to_apply: Citizens can report road quality or track village road works via the *Meri Sadak* mobile app.

name: Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
benefits: Holistic village development (health, education, sanitation, livelihoods, e-governance) through convergence of central and state schemes in MP-adopted Gram Panchayats.
eligibility: Gram Panchayats selected by Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha).
how_to_apply: Participate in Gram Sabha Village Development Plan (VDP) meetings in adopted villages.

name: National Bamboo Mission (NBM)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: 50% subsidy for bamboo plantation on non-forest land, nursery establishment, bamboo treatment plants, and artisan craft units.
eligibility: Farmers, bamboo artisans, SHGs, and entrepreneurs.
how_to_apply: Apply through the State Bamboo Mission / District Horticulture & Forestry Office.

name: AP Polam Pilustondi (Farmer Field Outreach & Advisory)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: Free bi-weekly village field visits by agricultural scientists and officials providing pest diagnostics, water-saving tips, soil-based fertilizer advice, and scheme awareness.
eligibility: All cultivating farmers across Andhra Pradesh villages.
how_to_apply: Attend the scheduled Tuesday/Wednesday Polam Pilustondi sessions organized at your village Rythu Seva Kendram.

name: Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF)
department: Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS), Agriculture Dept, AP
benefits: Free training, peer-to-peer handholding by Community Resource Persons (CRPs), and subsidized bio-inputs (Jeevamrutham, Beejamrutham) to transition to chemical-free natural farming.
eligibility: All farmers, tenant farmers, and landless women SHG members in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_apply: Contact the Natural Farming CRP or Village Agriculture Assistant at your Grama Sachivalayam.

name: National Mission on Edible Oils – Oil Palm (NMEO-OP – AP)
department: Department of Horticulture, AP
benefits: ₹29,000/hectare subsidy for oil palm planting material, ₹42,000/hectare for maintenance and intercropping over 4 years, plus Viability Price assurance to protect farmers from market crashes.
eligibility: Farmers in notified oil palm growing districts of Andhra Pradesh with assured irrigation.
how_to_apply: Register through the Horticulture Officer at your Rythu Seva Kendram.

name: AP Sericulture Development & Silk Samagra-2 Subsidy
state_or_central: Joint (Central Silk Board + AP Sericulture Dept)
department: Department of Sericulture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: 50%–75% subsidy (higher for SC/ST/Women) for mulberry plantation, silkworm rearing sheds, drip irrigation, and reeling machines.
eligibility: Farmers and women entrepreneurs taking up mulberry cultivation and silkworm rearing in AP.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Mandal/District Sericulture Office or Grama Sachivalayam.

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: ₹37,000/month (JRF) and ₹42,000/month (SRF) fellowship plus contingency grant and HRA for pursuing full-time M.Phil./Ph.D. degrees.
eligibility: SC candidates who have qualified UGC-NET / CSIR-NET and are admitted to full-time Ph.D. in recognized Indian universities.
how_to_apply: Apply online via the NSFDC / UGC Fellowship portal after NET results.

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe Students (NFST)
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: ₹37,000/month (JRF) and ₹42,000/month (SRF) plus annual contingency grant and HRA for full-time M.Phil./Ph.D. research.
eligibility: ST students admitted to regular full-time M.Phil./Ph.D. courses in recognized universities/institutes.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Ministry of Tribal Affairs Fellowship portal.

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NF-OBC)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via NBCFDC)
benefits: ₹37,000/month (JRF) and ₹42,000/month (SRF) plus contingency grant and HRA for full-time Ph.D. scholars.
eligibility: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) students who have qualified UGC-NET/CSIR-NET and enrolled in full-time Ph.D.
how_to_apply: Apply online via the NBCFDC Fellowship portal.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship (SHE – Scholarship for Higher Education)
department: Department of Science & Technology (DST)
benefits: ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 cash + ₹20,000 summer research mentorship grant) for up to 5 years for B.Sc./BS/Int. M.Sc. students in basic & natural sciences.
eligibility: Top 1% students in Class 12 State/Central Board exams (or JEE/NEET top 10,000 rankers) pursuing Basic/Natural Sciences.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the DST INSPIRE portal (`online-inspire.gov.in`).

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (up to 4 years Degree / 3 years Diploma) for tuition, books, and laptop.
eligibility: Orphans, children whose either/both parents died due to COVID-19, or wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action, pursuing AICTE-approved technical courses with family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`).

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
department: Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹70,000–₹80,000/month fellowship plus ₹2 Lakh/year research contingency grant (up to ₹10 Lakh over 5 years).
eligibility: Meritorious B.Tech/Integrated M.Tech/M.Sc. graduates from IITs, NITs, IISERs, IIITs, or top universities admitted to Ph.D. at PMRF-granting institutions.
how_to_apply: Apply through the admitting PMRF institution on the official PMRF portal.

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) on Education Loans
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year) on education loans up to ₹10 Lakh for technical/professional courses in India.
eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) students with annual parental income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakh taking an education loan from a scheduled bank.
how_to_apply: Apply through your lending bank branch or via the JanSamarth portal (`jansamarth.in`).

name: Dr. Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy (OBC / EBC Overseas Studies)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period on education loans for Master's, M.Phil., or Ph.D. studies abroad.
eligibility: OBC students (family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh/year) and EBC students (family income ≤ ₹5 Lakh/year) admitted to approved foreign universities.
how_to_apply: Apply through the lending bank branch (Canara Bank is the nodal bank) or JanSamarth portal.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation (MAEF), Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: ₹5,000/year (Classes 9–10) and ₹6,000/year (Classes 11–12) scholarship for meritorious minority girl students.
eligibility: Girl students from notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) scoring ≥ 50% in previous class with family income ≤ ₹2 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Central)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
benefits: Maintenance allowance (₹550–₹1,600/month), full non-refundable tuition fee reimbursement, book grant, and disability allowance.
eligibility: Students with ≥ 40% certified disability studying in Class 11 up to PG/Professional degrees with parental income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`).

name: Central Sector Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement (up to ₹2 Lakh/year for private institutes), ₹3,000/month living allowance, ₹5,000/year books, and ₹45,000 one-time grant for a laptop/computer.
eligibility: SC students admitted to notified premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs, etc.) with family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh/year.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (`scholarships.gov.in`).

name: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) for SC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: Full tuition fees, annual maintenance allowance ($15,400 USD / £9,900 GBP), contingency allowance, visa fee, medical insurance, and airfare for Master's/Ph.D. abroad.
eligibility: SC, Denotified/Nomadic Tribes, and Landless Agricultural Labourer students aged ≤ 35 years with ≥ 60% marks, family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh/year, and unconditional admission in QS Top-500 foreign universities.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the NOS portal (`nosmsje.gov.in`).

name: Vigyan Jyoti Programme (STEM Mentorship for Girls)
department: Department of Science & Technology (DST)
benefits: Free STEM mentoring, IIT/NIT lab visits, science camps, career counselling, and competitive exam preparation materials for high-school girls.
eligibility: Meritorious girl students studying in Classes 9 to 12 in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) and partner government schools.
how_to_apply: Enroll through your district's designated JNV Vigyan Jyoti Knowledge Partner hub.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
department: Ministry of Education
benefits: Integrated funding for free textbooks, uniforms, smart classrooms, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBVs), vocational labs, and inclusive education for children with special needs (Pre-school to Class 12).
eligibility: All students enrolled in Government and Government-Aided schools.
how_to_apply: Benefits are delivered directly through government schools and KGBVs.

name: PM-USHA (Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan)
department: Ministry of Education
benefits: Grants to State Universities and Colleges (including AP state universities) for modernizing labs, hostels, digital infrastructure, and multidisciplinary NEP 2020 courses.
eligibility: State Government Universities and Government/Aided Colleges; benefits all enrolled students.
how_to_apply: Institutions submit proposals via the PM-USHA portal; students benefit from upgraded campus facilities.

name: SWAYAM (Free Online Courses & Credit Transfer)
department: Ministry of Education (NPTEL, AICTE, UGC, NCERT)
benefits: 100% free online video courses from IIT/IIM/Central University professors across Engineering, Management, Humanities, and School subjects, with optional proctored certification and university credit transfer.
eligibility: Open to all learners (Class 9 to PG and working professionals; no age or income limit).
documents_required: Email ID / Mobile Number (ID card only for optional paid exam).
how_to_apply: Sign up free on `swayam.gov.in` and enroll in any active course.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
department: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
benefits: Paid on-the-job apprenticeship training in industry with government DBT stipend support (25% of stipend up to ₹1,500/month directly to the apprentice's bank account).
eligibility: Indian youth aged 14+ (18+ for hazardous industries) with minimum Class 5 to ITI/Graduate qualifications depending on the trade.
how_to_apply: Register as a candidate on `apprenticeshipindia.gov.in` and apply to open industry apprenticeships.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0)
department: Ministry of Education (BOAT)
benefits: 1-year paid industry apprenticeship for Engineering Graduates, Diploma holders, and General Stream Graduates with minimum monthly stipend of ₹8,000–₹9,000 (50% shared by Government via DBT).
eligibility: Indian citizens who have passed B.Tech/BE, Diploma, or General Degree (BA/BSc/BCom) within the last 5 years.
how_to_apply: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal (`nats.education.gov.in`) and apply to notified PSU/private establishments.

name: Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL – Atal Innovation Mission)
department: NITI Aayog
benefits: ₹20 Lakh grant to schools to set up hands-on robotics, 3D printing, IoT, and electronics innovation labs for school students.
eligibility: Government and private schools (Classes 6–12); benefits all students studying in ATL schools and nearby community schools.
how_to_apply: Schools apply on `aim.gov.in`; students access free STEM kits at their school's ATL.

name: AP Gurukulam (APSWREIS / APTWREIS / MJPAPBCWREIS) Free Residential Schools
department: Social, Tribal & BC Welfare Residential Educational Institutions Societies, AP
benefits: 100% free English-medium residential schooling (Classes 5 to 12), hostel, nutritious food, uniforms, books, and free IIT-JEE/NEET coaching.
eligibility: SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority students domiciled in AP from families with annual income ≤ ₹1 Lakh, selected via AP Gurukulam entrance test (APREIS/BRAGUCET).
how_to_apply: Apply online during the annual AP Gurukulam admission notification (Feb–Apr) and appear for the entrance test.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
department: National Health Mission (NHM), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cash assistance of ₹700 (rural) / ₹600 (urban) in high-performing states like AP (up to ₹1,400 in low-performing states) for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
eligibility: Pregnant women aged 19+ from BPL, SC, or ST families delivering in a Government hospital or accredited private facility (up to 2 live births).
how_to_apply: Register pregnancy with your local ASHA worker or ANM at the Village Clinic / PHC.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: 100% free normal/C-section delivery, free drugs, free diagnostics, free blood transfusion, free diet during hospital stay, and free treatment for sick newborns up to 1 year of age.
eligibility: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and all sick infants up to 1 year (no income limit).
how_to_apply: Walk into any Government PHC, CHC, Area Hospital, or District Hospital.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free early screening and free tertiary surgical/medical treatment for children against "4 Ds": Defects at birth, Deficiencies, Diseases, and Developmental delays (30+ conditions including congenital heart defects).
eligibility: All children aged 0 to 18 years enrolled in Anganwadis and Government/Aided schools.
how_to_apply: Mobile Health Teams visit Anganwadis and schools regularly; parents can also visit District Early Intervention Centres (DEICs) at District Hospitals.

name: Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free adolescent health counselling, Weekly Iron & Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS), menstrual hygiene pads at subsidized rates, and Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHCs).
eligibility: All adolescent boys and girls aged 10 to 19 years (in-school and out-of-school).
how_to_apply: Visit your nearest Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic (AFHC) at a PHC/CHC or participate via school/Anganwadi sessions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free, assured, specialist OB/GYN antenatal checkups, ultrasound, and lab tests on the **9th of every month** to detect and manage high-risk pregnancies.
eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimester across India.
how_to_apply: Visit any Government PHC, CHC, or District Hospital on the 9th day of any month.

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (TB Patient Nutrition Support)
department: Central TB Division, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: ₹1,000 per month direct cash transfer (DBT) for nutritional support throughout the entire duration of Tuberculosis treatment, plus free TB medicines.
eligibility: All notified Tuberculosis (TB) patients undergoing treatment in public or private hospitals registered on the Ni-kshay portal.
how_to_apply: Automatically enrolled when your doctor/PHC registers your TB diagnosis on the Ni-kshay portal.

name: National Programme for Control of Blindness & Visual Impairment (NPCBVI)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free cataract surgeries with Intraocular Lens (IOL) implants, free spectacles for school children and BPL elderly, and free treatment for glaucoma/diabetic retinopathy.
eligibility: All citizens (especially BPL elderly and school children) needing eye care.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card / BPL Card (for free spectacles).
how_to_apply: Visit the Ophthalmology wing of any Government District Hospital or authorized NGO eye camp.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM – ABHA Health ID)
department: National Health Authority (NHA)
benefits: Free 14-digit unique ABHA Health ID enabling paperless hospital OPD registration (Scan & Share) and secure digital storage/sharing of lab reports and prescriptions across India.
eligibility: Open to all residents of India.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card or Driving License and Mobile Number.
how_to_apply: Generate your ABHA ID online in 2 minutes at `abha.abdm.gov.in` or via the ABHA mobile app.

name: e-Sanjeevani National Telemedicine Service
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: 100% free online video/audio doctor consultations and digital e-prescriptions from home or Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
eligibility: All citizens of India (no income limit).
how_to_apply: Log in at `esanjeevani.mohfw.gov.in` or download the eSanjeevani OPD app.

name: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme – Dial 14416)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: 24×7 free, confidential mental health counselling and psychiatric support in 20+ regional languages (including Telugu, Hindi, and English) via toll-free helpline 14416.
eligibility: Open to all citizens of India experiencing stress, anxiety, depression, or emotional distress.
how_to_apply: Dial **14416** or **1-800-891-4416** from any phone, or use the Tele-MANAS mobile app.

name: Anaemia Mukt Bharat (AMB)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free Iron & Folic Acid (IFA) tablets/syrup, bi-annual deworming (Albendazole), digital hemoglobin testing, and treatment for severe anemia.
eligibility: Children (6 months–9 years), adolescents (10–19 years), pregnant/lactating women, and women of reproductive age (20–49 years).
how_to_apply: Access free IFA supplements at Anganwadi Centres, Government Schools, Village Clinics, and PHCs.

name: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP)
department: Directorate General of Health Services, MoHFW
benefits: Free rapid diagnostic testing, free medicines for Malaria, Dengue, Chikungunya, Kala-Azar, Lymphatic Filariasis, and free insecticide-treated mosquito nets in high-risk tribal/rural areas.
eligibility: All residents of India (special focus on endemic rural and tribal districts).
how_to_apply: Contact your village ASHA worker or nearest Government PHC.

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: One-time financial assistance up to ₹15 Lakh for life-threatening diseases (cancer, heart, kidney, liver transplants) treated at Government Super-Specialty Hospitals / AIIMS.
eligibility: BPL patients suffering from major life-threatening illnesses who are not covered under PM-JAY/state schemes for that procedure.
documents_required: Medical Estimate signed by the Head of Dept/Medical Superintendent of Govt Hospital.
how_to_apply: Submit application through the Medical Superintendent of the treating Government Hospital.

name: Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund (HMCPF)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹2 Lakh (up to ₹5 Lakh in exceptional cases) for BPL cancer patients undergoing treatment at 27 notified Regional Cancer Centres (RCCs).
eligibility: BPL cancer patients receiving treatment at recognized Regional Cancer Centres.
how_to_apply: Apply directly through the Medical Social Worker / Director of the Regional Cancer Centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY)
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Access to affordable, world-class tertiary healthcare and super-specialty OPD/IPD services at newly established AIIMS (including **AIIMS Mangalagiri in Andhra Pradesh**) and upgraded Government Medical Colleges.
eligibility: Open to all citizens of India.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card / ABHA ID (for OPD registration).
how_to_apply: Book an OPD appointment online via the ORS portal (`ors.gov.in`) or walk into AIIMS Mangalagiri.

name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) Scheme
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti)
benefits: Free emergency shelter, medical aid, police assistance, legal counselling, and psycho-social support under one roof for women affected by violence.
eligibility: Any woman or girl (below 18 also assisted via CWC) facing domestic violence, harassment, trafficking, or abuse—irrespective of caste, income, or marital status.
how_to_apply: Walk into your District One Stop Centre (usually near the District Government Hospital) or dial **181**.

name: Women Helpline Scheme (Dial 181)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefits: 24×7 toll-free emergency response, police/ambulance linkage, and information on all government women welfare schemes.
eligibility: Any woman or girl in distress anywhere in India.
how_to_apply: Dial **181** from any mobile or landline.

name: Shakti Sadan (Integrated Relief & Rehabilitation Home for Women)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti)
benefits: Free safe shelter, food, clothing, medical care, legal aid, and vocational skill training for women in distress and survivors of trafficking.
eligibility: Destitute women, widows without support, domestic violence survivors, homeless women, and rescued trafficking survivors.
documents_required: Basic identity proof (not mandatory for emergency admission).
how_to_apply: Contact the District Women & Child Development Officer, One Stop Centre, or dial **181**.

name: Sakhi Niwas (Working Women Hostel Scheme)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefits: Safe, affordable hostel accommodation with daycare/creche facilities for working women and women undergoing job training away from home.
eligibility: Working women (single, widowed, divorced, or married whose husband/family lives in another city) with gross monthly income ≤ ₹50,000 (metro) or ₹35,000 (non-metro).
how_to_apply: Apply directly at the nearest Sakhi Niwas / Working Women Hostel or through the District WCD Office.

name: Palna Scheme (National Creche Scheme)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti)
benefits: Safe daycare facilities, supplementary nutrition, growth monitoring, and early childhood care for children of working mothers at nominal/free charges.
eligibility: Working mothers (both rural and urban, formal or informal sector) with children aged 6 months to 6 years.
how_to_apply: Enroll your child at the nearest Anganwadi-cum-Creche or standalone Palna Creche centre.

name: Hub for Empowerment of Women (HEW – Sankalp)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefits: District-level guidance centres helping women access government schemes, financial literacy, legal rights, skill training, and entrepreneurship support.
eligibility: All women and adolescent girls in the district.
how_to_apply: Visit the District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW) at your District Collectorate / WCD Office.

name: Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefits: Free take-home nutritious food rations, iron/folic acid supplements, health checkups, and vocational/life-skills training to bring out-of-school girls back to formal education or livelihoods.
eligibility: Out-of-school adolescent girls aged 14 to 18 years in Aspirational Districts and notified blocks.
how_to_apply: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre.

name: PM CARES for Children Scheme
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefits: ₹10 Lakh corpus on turning 23 (with monthly stipend from age 18–23), free school education, ₹20,000/year scholarship, free ₹5 Lakh Ayushman health insurance, and interest-free higher education loans.
eligibility: Children who lost both parents, surviving parent, or legal guardian to COVID-19 between March 2020 and February 2022.
how_to_apply: Managed through District Child Protection Units (DCPU) and the PM CARES for Children portal.

name: SMILE Scheme (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood & Enterprise)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: Scholarships for transgender students, free gender-affirming healthcare via Ayushman Bharat TG Plus, Garima Greh shelter homes, skill training, and rehabilitation for persons engaged in begging.
eligibility: Transgender persons holding a National Transgender ID Card and persons engaged in begging.
documents_required: Transgender Certificate & ID Card (from National Portal).
how_to_apply: Register on the National Portal for Transgender Persons (`transgender.dosje.gov.in`).

name: SHRESHTA (Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: 100% free school tuition and residential hostel fees (up to ₹1.35 Lakh/year) in top CBSE-affiliated private residential schools for Classes 9 to 12.
eligibility: Meritorious SC students studying in Class 8 or Class 10 with parental annual income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh who qualify in the NTA NETS exam.
how_to_apply: Apply online for the NTA SHRESHTA (NETS) entrance exam at `exams.nta.ac.in/SHRESHTA`.

name: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY)
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: Integrated village infrastructure grant (₹20 Lakh+ per village) for drinking water, roads, street lights, Anganwadis, and 100% saturation of welfare schemes in SC-majority villages.
eligibility: Villages with > 40% Scheduled Caste population and total population ≥ 500.
how_to_apply: Implemented by District Social Welfare Officers and Gram Panchayats.

name: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana (VKY)
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Holistic tribal development funding for Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS), forest-produce livelihoods, drinking water, and healthcare in tribal blocks.
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe communities residing in notified tribal blocks/ITDA areas.
documents_required: ST Caste Certificate (for individual beneficiary components like EMRS admission).
how_to_apply: Contact your local Integrated Tribal Development Agency (ITDA) office.

name: PM-JANMAN (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan)
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (with 9 Line Ministries)
benefits: Targeted saturation of pucca houses (₹2.39 Lakh), piped water, solar electricity, mobile medical units, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, and road connectivity for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
eligibility: Members of the 75 notified PVTG communities (such as Chenchu, Savara, Kondareddi, Gadaba, Yanadi/sub-groups in AP).
how_to_apply: Enrolled via doorstep saturation camps conducted by ITDA and Grama Sachivalayams.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Scheme for Social Integration through Inter-Caste Marriages
department: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefits: ₹2.5 Lakh financial incentive (₹1.5 Lakh via RTGS + ₹1 Lakh in 3-year fixed deposit) to promote social integration.
eligibility: Newly married couples where one spouse is from a Scheduled Caste (SC) and the other is from a Non-SC community; first marriage registered under Hindu Marriage Act; must apply within 1 year of marriage.
how_to_apply: Submit application recommended by an MP/MLA or District Collector/District Social Welfare Officer to Dr. Ambedkar Foundation.

name: AP Chandranna Pelli Kanuka (Marriage Financial Assistance)
department: Social, Tribal, BC, Minority & Differently Abled Welfare Departments, AP
benefits: Direct financial marriage assistance (₹40,000 to ₹1,00,000 depending on SC/ST/BC/Minority/Disabled/Inter-caste category) credited to the bride's/mother's account.
eligibility: BPL brides domiciled in Andhra Pradesh aged 18+ (groom aged 21+), Class 10 pass (where applicable), with AP Rice Card.
how_to_apply: Register before or within the notified window after marriage at your Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)
department: Department of Posts, Ministry of Finance
benefits: Safe, sovereign-guaranteed savings certificate that doubles your lump-sum investment in 115 months (9 years 7 months at 7.5% p.a. compounded annually); no upper investment limit.
eligibility: Any resident Indian adult (single or joint) or guardian on behalf of a minor.
how_to_apply: Purchase at any India Post Office or authorized bank branch starting from ₹1,000.

name: National Savings Certificate (NSC VIII Issue)
department: Department of Posts, Ministry of Finance
benefits: 5-year government-backed fixed-income investment earning 7.7% p.a. compounded annually, eligible for Section 80C income tax deduction up to ₹1.5 Lakh/year.
eligibility: Resident Indian citizens (individuals/joint/minors).
how_to_apply: Open an NSC account at any Post Office or via India Post Internet Banking.

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
department: Ministry of Finance (via India Post & Authorized Banks)
benefits: Short-term 2-year sovereign-backed deposit scheme for women offering 7.5% p.a. quarterly compounded interest on deposits from ₹1,000 up to ₹2 Lakh, with partial withdrawal option after 1 year.
eligibility: Any Indian woman or guardian on behalf of a minor girl child.
how_to_apply: Open at any Post Office or participating public/private sector bank branch.

name: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
department: Department of Posts, Ministry of Finance
benefits: Guaranteed monthly interest payout (7.4% p.a.) over a 5-year tenure; maximum deposit ₹9 Lakh (single account) or ₹15 Lakh (joint account).
eligibility: Any resident Indian citizen (ideal for retirees and homemakers seeking regular monthly income).
how_to_apply: Visit your nearest India Post Office and submit the POMIS account opening form.

name: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Scheme
department: Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Ministry of Finance
benefits: Government-backed gold investment denominated in grams of 999 purity gold, paying 2.5% p.a. extra interest semi-annually, with 100% capital gains tax exemption on maturity (8 years).
eligibility: Resident Indian individuals, HUFs, Trusts, and Universities (minimum 1 gram, max 4 kg per fiscal year).
how_to_apply: Apply during RBI subscription tranches via net banking, Post Offices, or stockbrokers.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme
department: DPIIT & Respective Line Ministries
benefits: 4% to 6% direct financial incentives on incremental sales of goods manufactured in India across 14 strategic sectors (electronics, pharma, textiles, solar PV, drones, food processing, automobiles).
eligibility: Domestic and global manufacturing companies meeting sector-specific minimum investment and incremental sales thresholds.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the respective sector's Project Management Agency (PMA) portal when application windows open.

name: MSME Samadhaan (Delayed Payment Monitoring Portal)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Fast-track legal recourse for Micro and Small Enterprises to recover delayed payments (beyond 45 days) with compound interest at 3× RBI bank rate through MSE Facilitation Councils (MSEFC).
eligibility: Any Udyam-registered Micro or Small Enterprise facing unpaid invoices from buyers (private or PSU/Govt).
how_to_apply: File a delayed payment application online at `samadhaan.msme.gov.in`.

name: Udyam Registration & Udyam Assist Platform (UAP)
department: Ministry of MSME
benefits: Free, instant lifetime MSME certificate unlocking priority-sector bank loans, collateral-free CGTMSE credit, government tender preferences, and state industrial subsidies.
eligibility: All Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (manufacturing or services) and Informal Micro Enterprises (via UAP).
how_to_apply: Self-register free of cost in 5 minutes on `udyamregistration.gov.in`.

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED – Zero Defect Zero Effect) Certification Scheme
department: Ministry of MSME
benefits: Up to 80% subsidy (Micro), 60% (Small), 50% (Medium) plus extra 10% for Women/SC/ST MSMEs on Bronze, Silver, and Gold quality certifications, plus ₹10,000 joining reward and bank interest concessions.
eligibility: All Udyam-registered manufacturing MSMEs.
how_to_apply: Take the free ZED Pledge and apply online at `zed.msme.gov.in`.

name: SFURTI (Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries)
department: Ministry of MSME
benefits: Up to ₹2.5 Crore (Regular Cluster, up to 500 artisans) or ₹5 Crore (Major Cluster, > 500 artisans) grant for Common Facility Centres, modern machinery, design, and market branding.
eligibility: Traditional artisan clusters (handloom, khadi, coir, pottery, Kalamkari, Kondapalli toys, bamboo) represented by NGOs, cooperatives, or SHG federations.
how_to_apply: Submit cluster proposals online via the SFURTI portal through Nodal Agencies (KVIC / Coir Board / IIE).

name: ASPIRE (Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries & Entrepreneurship)
department: Ministry of MSME
benefits: Grant up to ₹1 Crore for setting up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) to train rural youth in agro-based and rural micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Government/private training institutes, universities, and NGOs (rural youth benefit from free/subsidized incubation & skilling).
how_to_apply: Apply online on the ASPIRE portal (`aspire.msme.gov.in`).

name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy & Technology Upgradation Scheme (CLCS-TUS)
department: Ministry of MSME
benefits: 15% upfront capital subsidy (up to ₹15 Lakh on machinery loans up to ₹1 Crore) for upgrading to modern, well-established manufacturing technology.
eligibility: Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) upgrading existing machinery or setting up new units with approved technology.
how_to_apply: Apply through your Primary Lending Institution (Bank/SIDBI) on the MSME Champions portal.

name: National Career Service (NCS) Portal
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment
benefits: Free job matching with verified private/government employers, online skill courses (Microsoft/TCS iON), career counselling, and Model Career Centre job fairs.
eligibility: All job seekers, students, and employers across India.
documents_required: Aadhaar / UAN / PAN (for profile verification) and Resume.
how_to_apply: Register free of cost on `ncs.gov.in` or visit your District Employment Exchange / Model Career Centre.

name: Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme
department: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour
benefits: Full free medical care for worker and family, 70%–90% cash sickness/disablement benefit, 26 weeks paid maternity benefit, and monthly dependent pension on work-related death.
eligibility: Employees earning gross monthly wages up to ₹21,000 (₹25,000 for PwDs) working in factories/establishments with 10+ workers.
how_to_apply: Enrolled by employer on the ESIC portal; download your e-Pehchan card to avail ESIC hospital services.

name: Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) & EDLI Insurance Scheme
department: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
benefits: Tax-free retirement savings (8.25% interest p.a. approx.), monthly EPS-95 pension after 10 years of service, and free EDLI life insurance cover up to ₹7 Lakh for the employee's family.
eligibility: Salaried employees in establishments with 20+ workers (mandatory for basic wage ≤ ₹15,000/month; voluntary above).
how_to_apply: Employer generates your Universal Account Number (UAN); manage passbook, nominations, and withdrawals via the EPFO portal or UMANG app.

name: AMRUT 2.0 (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefits: 100% functional tap water connections to urban households, sewerage/septage management, rejuvenation of urban water bodies, and green parks.
eligibility: Residents of all statutory towns and cities across India (4,800+ ULBs).
documents_required: Property Tax / Urban Household ID (for new tap connection).
how_to_apply: Apply for municipal tap/sewerage connections via your Ward Sachivalayam or Municipal Corporation portal.

name: Smart Cities Mission
state_or_central: Central (Includes Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Tirupati & Amaravati in AP)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefits: Smart integrated command & control centres (CCTV safety), smart street lighting, pedestrian footpaths, cycle tracks, solar public buildings, and digital civic services.
eligibility: Residents of the 100 selected Smart Cities across India.
how_to_apply: Implemented by city Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs); citizens can access services via city smart-citizen apps.

name: HRIDAY (Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefits: Conservation of heritage monuments, improved civic infrastructure (roads, signage, lighting, sanitation), and tourism livelihoods around historic heritage zones.
eligibility: Citizens, artisans, and tourism workers in the 12 notified heritage cities (including Amaravati, AP).
how_to_apply: Implemented by State Urban Development and Heritage Authorities.

name: PRASHAD Scheme (Pilgrimage Rejuvenation & Spiritual Heritage Augmentation)
state_or_central: Central (Includes **Srisailam, Simhachalam, Annavaram & Amaravati** in AP)
department: Ministry of Tourism, Government of India
benefits: World-class pilgrim amenities including queue complexes, drinking water, illumination, eco-friendly transport, and interpretation centres at major pilgrimage sites.
eligibility: All pilgrims, tourists, and local hospitality/artisan communities around notified pilgrimage destinations.
how_to_apply: Infrastructure is developed by the Ministry of Tourism and AP Tourism Development Corporation (APTDC).

name: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Scheme
department: Ministry of Tourism, Government of India
benefits: Sustainable destination-centric eco-tourism and adventure tourism infrastructure creating local homestay, guide, and craft employment.
eligibility: Local communities, homestay owners, and tourists in notified tourism circuits.
documents_required: None for tourists (State tourism registration for homestays).
how_to_apply: Contact AP Tourism (APTDC) for homestay/guide registration under Swadesh Darshan 2.0.

name: UJALA (Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All)
department: Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), Ministry of Power
benefits: Subsidized, energy-efficient 9W LED bulbs, 20W LED tubelights, and 5-star BEE ceiling fans to cut household electricity bills by up to 50%.
eligibility: All domestic electricity consumers in India.
how_to_apply: Purchase from EESL UJALA distribution kiosks, Post Offices, or DISCOM offices.

name: Saubhagya (Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana)
department: Ministry of Power (via State DISCOMs)
benefits: Free domestic electricity connection (meter, service wire, and 1 LED bulb) for BPL households; ₹500 (payable in 10 monthly bill installments) for APL households.
eligibility: Un-electrified rural and poor urban households.
how_to_apply: Apply at your local AP DISCOM office or Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.

name: PM-WANI (Prime Minister's Wi-Fi Access Network Interface)
department: Department of Telecommunications (DoT)
benefits: Affordable high-speed public Wi-Fi hotspots at kirana stores, tea shops, and village centres, plus zero-license-fee business opportunity for small shopkeepers to become Public Data Offices (PDOs).
eligibility: Any citizen (to use Wi-Fi) or small shopkeeper/entrepreneur (to set up a PDO hotspot).
documents_required: Mobile Number (for users); Aadhaar & Broadband connection (for PDOs).
how_to_apply: Download any PM-WANI compliant app to connect, or register as a PDO via a registered PDOA on `pmwani.gov.in`.

name: BharatNet (Rural Optical Fibre Broadband)
department: Department of Telecommunications (DoT)
benefits: High-speed optical fibre internet connectivity to all Gram Panchayats, rural schools, PHCs, and affordable rural FTTH broadband connections for villagers.
eligibility: All rural Gram Panchayats, institutions, and households in covered villages.
how_to_apply: Contact your Grama Sachivalayam / Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) or AP FiberNet operator.

name: DigiLocker (Authentic Digital Document Wallet)
department: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY)
benefits: Free 1 GB cloud storage for legally valid digital copies of Aadhaar, Driving License, Vehicle RC, SSC/Inter Marks Memos, Caste/Income Certificates, and Ration Cards (legally at par with originals under IT Act).
eligibility: All Indian residents with an Aadhaar number or mobile number.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Mobile Number.
how_to_apply: Sign up free at `digilocker.gov.in` or via the DigiLocker mobile app.

name: UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance)
department: NeGD, Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY)
benefits: Single mobile app providing access to 1,700+ Central and State government services (EPFO, DigiLocker, Gas Booking, Ration Card, Scholarships, Pension status, Soil Health Card) in 13 Indian languages including Telugu.
eligibility: Open to all citizens of India.
how_to_apply: Download the UMANG app from Google Play Store / Apple App Store or visit `web.umang.gov.in`.

name: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan
department: Logistics Division, DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
benefits: GIS-based multimodal infrastructure planning integrating roads, railways, ports, airports, and logistics parks to cut logistics costs and boost industrial job creation across states.
eligibility: State governments, infrastructure agencies, and industrial/logistics investors.
how_to_apply: State departments access the PM GatiShakti NMP portal for coordinated infrastructure clearances.

name: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik – Regional Connectivity Scheme)
state_or_central: Central (Includes **Kadapa, Kurnool, Rajahmundry & Vijayawada** routes in AP)
department: Ministry of Civil Aviation
benefits: Capped, affordable regional airfares on underserved/unserved domestic routes to make air travel accessible to middle-class citizens.
eligibility: All air travellers booking seats on notified RCS-UDAN routes.
documents_required: Standard Government Photo ID for air travel.
how_to_apply: Book tickets directly through airlines operating UDAN routes (e.g., IndiGo, Star Air, Alliance Air).

name: PM E-DRIVE Scheme (Electric Vehicle Purchase Subsidy)
department: Ministry of Heavy Industries
benefits: Direct upfront purchase subsidy (e-Voucher) on electric two-wheelers (up to ₹5,000–₹10,000), electric three-wheelers/e-rickshaws (up to ₹25,000–₹50,000), e-ambulances, and e-trucks, plus public EV fast-charging network.
eligibility: Indian citizens and commercial fleet operators purchasing eligible EVs with advanced batteries from registered OEMs.
how_to_apply: The EV dealer generates your Aadhaar-authenticated PM E-DRIVE e-Voucher on the official portal at the time of purchase for instant price reduction.

name: National Green Hydrogen Mission
state_or_central: Central (Major Green Hydrogen Hubs developing in **Visakhapatnam / Kakinada, AP**)
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefits: Financial incentives (SIGHT programme) for electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen production, R&D grants, and skilled green-energy job creation.
eligibility: Clean energy companies, electrolyser manufacturers, R&D institutions, and industrial hubs.
how_to_apply: Participate in tenders issued by SECI / MNRE under the SIGHT and R&D components.
